2019
Impreza
Get more of what you want.
Subaru Impreza is the longest-lasting vehicle in its class.1
The Impreza was built to inspire your trust. You can count on the
Subaru Global Platform, built with high-strength steel for high
crash-energy absorption. You also have the famously reliable
SUBARU BOXER® engine with standard Subaru Symmetrical All-
Wheel Drive. And because 96% of Subaru Impreza cars sold in the
Long-Lasting
last 10 years are still on the road today,2 you can be confident that
your Impreza is ready for every twist and turn ahead.
The 2019 Impreza is available with the latest in safety tech.
EyeSight® Driver Assist Technology,3,4 Blind-Spot Detection and
Rear Cross-Traffic Alert3,5 are available to help you spot and avoid
danger. You can also add LED Steering Responsive Headlights
(SRH) with High Beam Assist (HBA) to help you maximize your
Safety-Focused visibility when driving at night.3 And for even more peace of
mind, the latest SUBARU STARLINK™ Safety and Security system
with Advanced Automatic Collision Notification is available.3,6
Responsive power and exceptional fuel economy give you extra
fun without added cost in the 2019 Impreza. It achieves up
to 38 highway MPG7 with standard Subaru Symmetrical All-
Wheel Drive, thanks to its reliable 152-hp SUBARU BOXER®
Fuel-Efficient engine with direct injection. Plus, it can go more than 450 miles
on a full tank, making it that much easier to roam as you please.8
Take your favorite content almost anywhere you go. The Impreza
features SUBARU STARLINK™ Multimedia with standard Apple
CarPlay™ and Android™ Auto app integration.9 For added
convenience, all-new Remote Engine Start with Climate
Well-Connected
Control10 and STARLINK™ Concierge Services are available.6

Hi-Tech Cabin
Come on in and play. The 2019 Impreza features SUBARU STARLINK™ Multimedia with standard Apple CarPlay,™
Android™ Auto and Pandora® app integration.1 The available voice-activated navigation system powered by
TomTom® features an easy-to-use 8-inch touchscreen.2 And the latest STARLINK™ Safety and Security system
now includes the all-new Remote Engine Start with Climate Control feature.3,4 Accessible via your smartphone, it
can help ensure your Impreza is ready and comfortable. And the new STARLINK™ Concierge Services can help
with tasks like navigation, restaurant reservations and scheduling service appointments.3
You can hear every note of your favorite tunes with the available 8-speaker 432-watt-equivalent Harman Kardon®
premium audio system.2 There’s also Keyless Access with Push-Button Start2 that not only makes getting on
your way a breeze, it even smartly prevents you from locking your keys in your car.
